all_13_methods.rule: Validate the profile. Select one complete installed-code context with the exact stream lifetime and Tenant sensitivity.
all_13_methods.rule_now: Data requires the exact stored profile body, one retained producer edge, the original generation and call, and the exact Discovery destination. Inspect checks and captured selection precede payload reads. The retained definition supplies immutable image closures.

all_13_methods.rule: Select all required Discovery exports and reject an incomplete installed set.
all_13_methods.rule_now: Native admission pins the actual selected destination call and its complete immutable closure. The old requirement to activate all four exports does not apply to one admitted image call. Destination and return identity checks remain.

all_13_methods.rule: Return sorted unique package revisions for authorization.
all_13_methods.rule_now: The manifest records actual image, digest, artifact, export, arguments, and dependencies. Current Run, Inspect, and image trust protect replay, including its final result.

all_13_methods.rule: Reject a wrong package, missing export, or repeated export.
all_13_methods.rule_now: The retained call ID, destination, descriptor, image identity, and closure must agree. No new active-export registry is used.

all_13_methods.rule: Read only one exact source and inclusive cursor range. Keep original framed bytes and order. Reject partial or capped input.
all_13_methods.rule_now: Query captures complete typed inputs once through native source plans. Data retains their Arrow bytes, order, revisions and coverage. Replay scans those saved tables and performs no live source read. Configured native input and row limits remain checked.

all_13_methods.rule: Use exact frozen code and input, compare the whole snapshot, and report missing input or packages as Unavailable. Do not publish.
all_13_methods.rule_now: The native call reuses original input, parameters, seed, time, state and exact historical closure. Analysis compares the complete returned snapshot. Missing saved input/code is Unavailable with original cursor bounds. Corrupt payloads remain errors. Final combined Run and Inspect checks protect the response.

all_13_methods.rule: Check source, CPU, contiguous cursor, coverage interval, accepted count, frozen facts and input bounds.
all_13_methods.rule_now: The original typed relation is saved with the exact attempt, call, generation, descriptor, context and coverage. Data checks retained input membership, slots, schema, batch count and row count. Native replay validates the descriptor and input shape before execution. Query memory and explicit input_bytes replace JSON and fixed-record ceilings. Original provenance validation remains on initial publication.

all_13_methods.rule: Match cursor, process, entry, binding, role, state, rule, kernel sequence and proof kind.
all_13_methods.rule_now: Initial result validation binds returned atoms to captured typed record metadata. Replay uses those exact retained record inputs and performs no new host join.

all_13_methods.rule: Keep the exact subject, image, configuration, process, entry, binding, role, state, rule, catalog, static key and policy.
all_13_methods.rule_now: The exact typed context input and its revision are retained. Replay does not query current context or reconstruct a weaker fact key.

all_13_methods.rule: Decode and validate the frozen fact object, all required pinned fields, and exact Control commit revision.
all_13_methods.rule_now: Native typed context capture and domain provenance checks validate the original input. The saved SDK Evaluation retains the exact admitted context bytes and revision. Corrupt saved payloads fail.

all_13_methods.rule: Process unconsumed chunks in order, retry a rejected chunk by splitting it, OR committed changes, and advance at most one accepted prefix.
all_13_methods.rule_now: Native plans pass the complete declared relation to each detector. Data makes one guarded atomic publication. Declared SQL controls a prefix; native Query acknowledgements drain later prefixes. A failed result advances no cursor. Fixed byte-driven split-and-retry is removed under disabled-default quotas.

all_13_methods.rule: Partition records before the fixed 255-context total, and reject one record with more than 255 contexts.
all_13_methods.rule_now: Complete Arrow relations replace fixed 255-context batching. Checked arithmetic, Query reservations and explicit limits remain. One record can retain more than 255 facts by default.

all_13_methods.rule: Return the first and last cursor or reject an empty window.
all_13_methods.rule_now: Canonical records are sorted by exact identity. Empty input fails before facts or publication. Graph output carries exact first and last cursors; guarded progress advances only to the accepted result end.

assertions: Keep unknown protobuf wire fields without re-encoding.
Exclude foreign source and CPU rows; retain every cursor in the inclusive range.

all_six_old_replay_tests.translation: Native source capture and saved Arrow input replace replay raw-range reads. The fixed DiscoveryConfig interval cap is removed; explicit native quotas remain.

assertions: Replay the complete original snapshot.
Keep original unresolved/excluded reasons and lifecycle records.
Make no current context-provider calls.
all_six_old_replay_tests.translation: The current API only accepts the exact retained profile. The old test edits a caller-owned profile and expects the edited value to replay. Data now rejects that edit as Conflict. This stronger retained-profile boundary is explicit; the old mutation-acceptance assertion is not a literal current assertion.

assertions: Reject absent retained context references.
Reject a context key that was not retained.
Reject ambiguous atom attribution.
Reject a changed whole snapshot.
all_six_old_replay_tests.translation: Exact stored profile equality rejects caller manifest/atom/snapshot edits. Missing actual saved inputs or image data is Unavailable. Malformed inputs and forged profiles remain errors; no false successful replay is returned.

assertions: Reject input one byte above its explicit byte limit.
Accept input at its exact explicit byte limit.
Reject an explicit record-count overflow.
all_six_old_replay_tests.translation: Limits measure native Evaluation allocations rather than old JSON bytes. Combined native input has exact total-1 rejection and total acceptance tests. The fixed default interval ceiling is removed.

assertions: Preserve the retained profile after raw retention.
Do not query a current fact provider.
Give exact original first/last cursors if the historical input is missing.
all_six_old_replay_tests.translation: Raw expiry no longer removes saved managed input, so replay succeeds after raw retention. Removing the actual saved input returns Unavailable with exact saved coverage bounds. The old raw-expiry Unavailable assertion is replaced by the stronger retained-input contract.

assertions: Keep the original exact code references after a new version is installed.
Replay the original snapshot through original code.
Do not let historical activation authorize current publication.
Preserve the profile when current execution is denied.
all_six_old_replay_tests.translation: Images and dependency closures remain pinned by admitted definitions after uninstall. New/current grant and original-image trust still protect replay. The old rule that removing current activation destroys historical replay is not the new image contract.

old_rules: Return package ID, export, revision, generation, root, parameters, target, and complete artifact identity.
Resolve the exact descriptor and selected implementation from the retained bundle.
current_rules: ManagedSpec binds the native definition digest and exact call IDs.
Each ManagedCall records image and image digest, package revision, export, target, artifact digest/closure/platform, native arguments, and dependencies.
Managed version/generation and saved Evaluation retain the exact input parameters and original result attribution.
Image inspection retains complete descriptors and implementation metadata. No active-export registry is used.

old_rules: Reject empty references, zero generation, repeated package/export, invalid names and unsupported targets.
Require tenant scope and current Run authority before loading original code.
Keep exact old root, export revision, parameters, target and artifact digest even after a new version becomes current.

current_rules: Inspect and captured-scope validation precede payload hydration. Current Run and original image trust protect execution.
Data selects the original stored generation and exact definition/call manifest. Query prepares that retained closure and checks its manifest.
The saved Evaluation keeps original context, parameters, all input relations and state. Descriptor validation rejects a wrong call, export, schema, parameter or tenant.
Native replay has no publication sink and changes no progress, history, evidence or current head. Final combined Run/Inspect checks protect disclosure.
Reservations and retained Arrow owners remain alive through use.

Images retained by admitted definitions survive uninstall. The old active-export requirement is removed by the new image contract. Fixed reference-count ceilings are removed by disabled-default quota rules.

old_rules: Take a fresh current snapshot and serialize lifecycle changes with publication.
Require each expected package/revision and exact active generation/revision/metadata.
Check every distinct retained grant and its exact bundle under one commit_many callback.
Call the operation at most once, and reject an authority provider that never invokes it.
current_rules: One admitted Instance owns one execution grant and its complete exact image closure; independent grants require independent instances. The old process-wide mixed-export snapshot is removed.
Instance::authorize_actions checks all actual images and required actions together. Option::take enforces one operation and a missing callback returns Denied.
The Data transaction verifies the exact spec, grant, generation, lifecycle, prior state, pending attempt, source revisions and current authority before mutation.
Host removal drains the native worker before completing the transition. Renewal, Stop and version replacement use the Data lifecycle CAS.
Replay has no publication target. A stale owner or captured attempt cannot publish after renewal, suspension, replacement or removal.

assertions: A valid shared-root commit calls its operation once.
Denying a second retained grant prevents the operation despite the first grant remaining valid.
old_assertion_map.translation: There is no mixed-grant active-export registry. Each Instance has one grant, with every actual image checked together. Independent grants have separate Instance owners. The old exact two-grant export-registry fixture is not a native API assertion.

assertions: Two owners share the lifecycle boundary.
Removal cannot pass the publication critical section.
An old snapshot cannot commit after removal.
old_assertion_map.translation: The Data transaction and native worker drain replace the process-local lifecycle mutex. No stale attempt can publish after the terminal lifecycle transition.

assertions: A second owner cannot collect a package while another owner holds the lifecycle boundary.
Cleanup occurs only after the boundary releases.
old_assertion_map.translation: Native owner construction performs no implicit package cleanup. Explicit Data image install/uninstall transactions retain closures referenced by admitted definitions. Constructor-driven garbage collection is absent.

assertions: Renewal waits for the active commit.

The old snapshot fails after renewal.
old_assertion_map.translation: Data lifecycle CAS and final transaction checks replace the shared legacy lock. Public renewal after reopen stays assigned to the retained owner.rs gap.

assertions: Suspension waits for an active commit.

The old snapshot fails after suspension.
old_assertion_map.translation: Native current-authority checks, cancellation/join and Data lifecycle CAS preserve one order between publication and suspension.
